annotations.title: Nursing home ratings and risk flags

description: Nursing home ratings and risk flags — Look up or search Medicare/Medicaid-certified US nursing homes in CMS Care Compare: Five-Star ratings (overall, inspections, quality, staffing), nurse staffing hours and turnover, fines and payment denials, abuse icon, Special Focus Facility status, ownership changes, chain, beds, location, plus a LOW/MODERATE/HIGH risk summary with plain-English concerns. Params: ccn= (CMS certification number) or name= (substring), city=, zip=, state= (2-letter); min_rating=1-5, limit=1-25 (default 10). Results sorted by overall rating. Pair with /v1/health/nursing-home-inspections?ccn= for the citation history. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_nursing_home
